data.title: 莱伊 · 散场后的座位
data.description: 观众散去后，她把旁边的座位拍了拍。你坐下时，莱伊有点不好意思，却没有移开靠近的肩膀。
data.action: 坐在舞台边，轻拍身旁座位
data.camera: 中近景，人物神态与互动清晰
data.promptProse: Sitting on the edge of a darkened theater stage with legs dangling after a lively band performance, Cautus girl Ray pats the wooden floorboards beside her, looking toward the viewer with a shy, endearing blush. Fading stage spotlights in violet and amber cast long shadows across scattered cables and amplifier cabinets, while her long floppy bunny ears droop softly in the quiet aftermath.
